text:
Jordan: heads up, staging linkcheck is complaining about TOC links after we enabled the MDX TOC plugin. several sidebar anchors now point to `#table-of-contents` instead of the section slug.

DocsBot: Linkcheck failed for build #802: https://ci.redwood/802 - step: linkcheck :warning:

Jordan: logs snippet:
```
WARN Broken fragment: /guides/runtime-ops.md#quick-reference -> fragment not found
WARN Redirected anchor: /guides/runtime-ops.md#toc -> redirected to /guides/runtime-ops.md#table-of-contents
```

Avery: I think the TOC plugin inserts an internal heading `Table of contents` that steals the `#toc` anchor and many sidebar links point at `#quick-reference` which MDX now prefixes with the page slug in sidebar contexts.

Felix: Ugh. I hit this when I added the TOC on a few long pages. The plugin generates a heading node which can change anchor generation order. Two fixes: 1) remove the injected TOC node from content and rely on sidebar links only, or 2) add explicit ids on the real headings and update sidebar refs.

Priya: How many broken refs? I grepped for `#quick-reference` and `#toc` across docs and examples: about 7 internal refs and 2 SDK snippets linking into that section.

Jordan: Minimal fix plan: add explicit IDs to the key headings in `guides/runtime-ops.md` (`### Quick reference {#quick-reference}`) and change the sidebar config to reference the page fragment explicitly. That should be backwards compatible for external links too.

Avery: Agree. Also probably worth changing the TOC plugin config to avoid generating a top-level `Table of contents` heading, or set it to `heading: false`. I'll open a small PR that adds the ids and tweaks the plugin config.

DocsBot: Suggested PR checklist:
- [ ] Add explicit heading ids for affected sections in `guides/runtime-ops.md`
- [ ] Update sidebar entries that reference page fragments to use explicit ids where necessary
- [ ] Toggle MDX TOC plugin option to avoid injecting top-level headings (if supported)
- [ ] Run `pnpm docs:build && pnpm docs:linkcheck` locally
- [ ] Update migration note about TOC plugin behavior in `docs/MIGRATION.md`

Felix: If you add explicit ids, please also update the two SDK snippets that contain links to `#quick-reference`. I can scan the examples dir for any other usages before we merge.

Avery: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102 - adds `{#quick-reference}` to the headings, updates sidebar fragment entries, and flips TOC plugin setting to `heading: false`.

DocsBot: PR 1102 - linkcheck job queued.

Felix: Ran `pnpm docs:linkcheck` locally against the branch; fixed the two SDK snippet links and updated an example README. All fragments present.

DocsBot: CI for PR 1102 - linkcheck passed :white_check_mark:. Build green.

Jordan: Merged. Staging linkcheck is green and sidebar links resolve correctly. Thanks all.

Priya: Filing a small follow-up to add a pre-merge check that warns when the TOC plugin injects a top-level heading; might save future regressions.

Avery: Good idea — will add that to the docs infra backlog. Closing thread. :tada:
